flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Chemicals is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.76) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

strengths.evidence: Technical score 100/100 - RS rating 100 (market-beating); +11% vs Nifty 500 (3M); above 200-DMA

strengths.point: ROCE runs well ahead of the sector median.
ROA runs well ahead of the sector median.
Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.
Relative strength is in the top tier of the market.
Chemicals is in a tailwind - the macro backdrop is supportive.
The 50-day average has crossed above the 200-day average.
The stock has beaten its benchmark over the past year.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -0.05 pp

opportunities.point: Pasupati Acrylon expects sustained demand growth across all its segments.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Your Company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company expects to commence commercial production of its 150 KLPD grain-based Ethanol Project by September 2024.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and started commercial production in March 2025.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company spent around Rs. 188 Crore on the ethanol project, funded via Rs. 104 Crore term loan and the balance from internal accruals.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The demand for acrylic fibers is expected to rise due to macroeconomic growth in end-use sectors.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: Sales of acrylic fibres are projected to grow driven by end-use sectors such as apparel, home furnishing, and industrial applications.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The rapid growth of end-use sectors including apparel, home furnishing, and industrial will therefore continue to propel the sales of acrylic fibres in the upcoming years." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company's Acrylic products manufacturing plant has an installed capacity of 42,000 MT per annum.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company produced 35,198 MT and sold 33,850 MT of Acrylic Fibre in FY 2024-25.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company is exploring options to increase its exports of Acrylic Fiber.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "The Company has exported to Dubai, Peru, Thailand, Morrocco, Tunisia, Nepal, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Brazil, Poland, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company continuously explores opportunities to optimize and reduce energy costs.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "The company is continuously exploring various avenues to reduce and optimize energy cost." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Global acrylic fibre consumption is affected by price volatility in raw materials, energy, coal, and key inputs.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations impact margins as the company depends on imports.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The company has no control over ethanol product prices as they are determined by Oil Marketing Companies.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S19/W6/O28/T12), led by 'Pasupati Acrylon expects sustained demand growth across all its segments', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
